dataset.name: Australian high-grade serous ovarian cancer (ICGC OV-AU)
dataset.description: Independent Australian high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: FIGO stage III-IV high-grade serous ovarian, fallopian-tube or primary-peritoneal cancers. Primary solid tumors are preferred; a recurrent or metastatic tumor is selected only when no eligible primary RNA-seq profile exists.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer uses endpoint-complete donors with an open Ensembl/FPKM RNA-seq analysis linked to a prespecified tumor-specimen class. One analysis is selected deterministically per donor.

specimen_type_priority: Metastatic tumour - metastasis to distant location

samples.sample_type_default: Primary or recurrent high-grade serous ovarian cancer

include: Metastatic tumour - metastasis to distant location

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Ambiguous symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl gene are removed before the matrix is written.
expression.scale_note: ICGC provides non-negative RSEM FPKM values. TRACE Explorer maps Ensembl identifiers with the pinned GRCh37 reference and applies log2(value + 1) once.
